thread:
Emily L.: Heads-up — AthenaPay submitted a formal intake. They want a 100k-token long-context variant, with both base and instruct flavors. Preference for int4 quant to hit cost targets. Asking for prioritization, risks, and a bring-up checklist. Doc: https://drive.internal/athenapay-longctx (shared).

Raj P.: thanks — critical Qs: latency SLO? peak qps? and is this Dedicated or Private? 100k changes kernel assumptions.

Emily L.: Enterprise customer, Dedicated preferred (SLA + data isolation). SLA target: p95 < 2s for prompt lengths <= 4k, best-effort beyond that. Expected burst qps small (5–10), steady qps ~0.2. NDA in flight.

Maria S.: flagged for solutions: we need to confirm PII handling on their sample prompts. Also confirm whether they expect instruction-tuned behavior (instruct) vs raw base.

Zoe (Infra): FYI — current runtime supports up to ~64k with optimized kernel; 100k will need either kernel extension or segmented chunking. KV cache sizing note: 100k tokens * ~8 bytes/token ~= 800KB? that seems low — I'll do a proper estimate. Also disk for prefix caching and checkpoint sizes.

Andrew Q.: For eval we'll want: perplexity, instruction-following score (LLM-eval style), hallucination rate on curated finance QA, and regression delta vs our 32k baseline. Need a reproducible eval harness.

Raj P.: quantization note — int4 can give noticeable accuracy drop on some heads. Plan: run GPTQ sweep and small QAT if needed. Quick local command to kick off a sweep:
```
# quick GPTQ smoke run
python tools/quantize.py --model /mnt/models/athena-base --bits 4 --calib 2048 --out /tmp/q4_athena
```
I'll capture downstream eval metrics after each checkpoint.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: /infra/checklists/longctx-variant. Items: infra-approval, kernel-compat, KV-cache config, cost-est, eval-suite attached.

Zoe (Infra): rough KV calc: assume 100k tokens * 2 bytes/token for kv (packed) * 2 (key+value) ~= 400KB per request? hmm my previous guess was off. Need to account for dtype expansion during runtime. Recommend memory budget estimate: 60–96GB GPU for single-stream 100k with full attention unless we shard + custom kernels. Suggest prototype with 64k+windowing fallback while ML implements 100k kernels.

Raj P.: agree on fallback. For prioritization: high business impact but medium engineering cost because kernels + quant. Recommend priority = P1 (schedule within 3 weeks) if legal signs NDA. Owners: Raj -> model/quant, Andrew -> evals, Zoe -> infra, Maria -> customer comms.

Emily L.: putting owners in place. Timeline: kickoff + dataspec this week, proto quant sweep week 1, infra prototype & fallback week 2, end-to-end QA & canary week 3.

Andrew Q.: I'll scaffold an eval called "finance-100k-longctx". Quick eval snippet: 
```
python eval/run_eval.py --suite suites/finance_qa.json --model /tmp/q4_athena --out results/athena_q4_eval.json
```
We'll track instr-follow F1, hallucination rate, and latency percentiles.

Maria S.: I'll book a kickoff with AthenaPay for Wed 10am PT and ask them to upload a 200-example sample set with redacted PII. Also confirming whether they want identical behavior between base and instruct or prefer instruct tuned for safety.

Raj P.: I'll start a triage branch: github.com/redwood/athena-longctx/tree/triage-1802. Need a labeled calibration set (2k sequences) and a few long-context prompts (50 examples >50k). Maria can set the sample expectations.

Zoe (Infra): one operational risk: checkpoint + KV cache persistence during preemptions. For Dedicated we can pin instances but still need robust resume. Logging added to infra checklist.

Emily L.: Decision notes: proceed as P1 pending NDA. Action items: Maria schedule kickoff, Raj start quant sweep, Andrew create eval harness and baseline runs, Zoe prototype fallback infra & estimate cost. We'll track tasks in GH and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

Raj P.: quick ask — does anyone have past GPTQ int4 regressions data for finance domain? could speed triage.

Andrew Q.: I have a small table of regressions from last year; I'll upload to the GH issue during setup.

Emily L.: thanks all — keeping this thread as central log. Updates as tasks progress.
